name: Extendable outdoor table 160-240x90x75 cm in anthracite painted aluminum
description: The Cremona table is an extendable outdoor table, excellent for being placed in the garden and thanks to its large size it can accommodate up to 8 people. It has an aluminum structure and thanks to the good quality of its materials, the table is highly resistant to atmospheric agents. It is equipped with an opening system that allows it to reach 240 cm in width.
